title: Killdozer
description:
Destroy the town.Bulldoze your way through 8 unique towns with your Killdozer.

Upgrade Your Killdozer.Unlock 75+ unique weapons, items, and upgrades.

Unlock new Killdozers.Dozer variants have unique capabilities and starting bonuses.

Game OverviewKilldozer is a destruction-based action roguelike with bullet hell elements. Use your mouse to drive an armored bulldozer. Destroy 8 towns without dying to win. 

Along the way, upgrade your Killdozer at a barn, adding weapons, armor, explosives, and more.

Police will try everything they can to stop you. SWAT teams, Drones, Snipers, Tanks, and more.
description_short: Destroy the town! Killdozer is an action roguelike where you fight off a police onslaught while bulldozing towns. Unlock items and upgrades along the way to build your Killdozer into the ultimate destruction machine.
